reviews.text: This business is very efficient and the staff are all so caring toward the animals and their owners. I appreciate their detailed explanations of diagnosis and treatment needed. I also like that the staff says to call if any concerns or questions come up after leaving.
Such a loving and caring team of incredibly committed, and compassionate vets.  My dog was in critical condition when we brought her in and I’m thrilled to say she is home now and doing very well.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

Our dog developed sudden bloody diarrhea. She was seen by our local Vet who promptly transferred him to  VSH-SV where he received excellent care. He was discharged two days later much improved. Now, a week later now at home, he is back to normal. Everybody was caring and professional. We are grateful.

This Hospital saved my dog's life. So I love coming here than going to other places who just take your money and they say oh we can't help you hear you need to go to specialist. So this is top notch to our family. We thank you for Max doing the best for our Minnie.

Dr Moeller was great! She was very patient with our English Bulldog, explaining everything that needed to be done. Surgery was successful - our fur baby is recovering well from the eye surgery. Will recommend.
It was clear Dr. Derensky had reviewed all my dog’s records. If she was in a rush I had no clue. I felt like she spent a lot of time listening to me, asking questions & explaining options to me.

From the moment we walked in, the front desk team was gentle and understanding. They immediately brought us into a private, quiet room so we could have space to process everything.
The vet technicians and Dr. I didn't get their names but this happened on September 28 2026 between 3:15AM-4:30AM. They explained the entire process with so much patience, never rushing us, and treated our dog GIGI with the utmost respect and tenderness. They allowed us all the time we needed to say our final goodbyes and they even provide us with some threats for GIGI. I cannot thank the team at VSH San Diego enough for the incredible care and compassion they showed us during one of the hardest days of our lives. We had to make the devastating decision to euthanize our beloved dog, GIGI, and the staff made a heartbreaking experience as peaceful and dignified as possible. I highly recommend VSH to anyone facing an emergency or a difficult end of life decision for their pet.

The team took incredible care of my girl who had a stroke that impacted her spinal cord. They gave me regular updates while she was in hospital, were very supportive throughout our difficult conversations, and made me feel reassured every step of the way. When I picked her up they provided detailed instructions to help me manage her care at home and have checked in consistently since I’ve brought her home. We have a journey ahead of us but I’m confident that their support will help us make the best of a really tough situation.

NEVER take your pet here. I almost put down my french bulldog. They put him under anesthesia and intubation without my approval. Had to forcefully remove my sick dog from the premises. (My dog was completely fine 5 days later) terrible terrible don’t go here go anywhere else

It was great! I really appreciated how well they treated me & my poor sick dog😢 They knew exactly what to do & he is healing exactly as they said he would w/ the prescribed medication.
One thing I am disappointed about is that there was no follow through.

Took my dog in for her 2nd ACL replacement at Veterinary Specialty Hospital and once again the staff was very professional and friendly.  1st ACL replacement was a success and looking forward for the same results on the 2nd ACL replacement.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

The staff is kind, the vets are great, they saved our golden retriever, Max.  He aspirated some food, got pneumonia and went downhill within a day.  They made all the right decisions and now our lucky boy is home!  Thank you!

Great staff! Wonderful doctors and excellent care! From the moment I called in to let them know my dog was having an emergency until  the time he was discharged… I felt he was in kind, knowledgeable and charismatic hands!

Stanley sees Internal Medicine to manage his hyperthyroidism. His vet personally calls to share blood test results & discuss care.

My UCSD medical team could learn from this.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
Fabulous treatment!  My pet was well taken care off 🙏🏻 thank you to all envolved …
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
Good Dr s took good care of my dog Very good communication on treatment options

Everyone is very welcoming. There is plenty of space to sit with your dog or cat to wait for your appointment. It did take a long time to get my appointment, but to schedule the surgery my dog needs is only a week away

As always the care of my kitty and respect for me was exceptional. Explanation was easy for me to understand. VSH is my go to care when I am unable to see my regular vet. By the way—she always says to call VSH when she in unavailable.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
Very caring and personal service.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
Great place.  Staff & Doctors take the time to explain everything.👍 …

Professional, kind, and truly knowledgeable. The specialists and staff handled my baby (dog) with so much gentleness and care. Highly recommend the neurology department to any pet parent facing complex health concerns.!! Thank you Dr Erica Fox!

We are new to San Diego and so grateful to have found Dr. Moeller and the ophthalmology staff at VSH.  They have provided excellent and compassionate care for our Shih Tzu who has a long history of eye issues.  They are very thorough and we can get an appointment when we need them.  We have found that specialty veterinary care is expensive everywhere.

I scheduled an appointment for their first opening, but they had a cancellation and were able to see me sooner. I hit a ton of traffic and was late by 20 minutes; when I called to let them know, they told me not to worry and to drive safely. The wait for non-urgent walk-ins when I got there was 2 hours.

I didn't even wait 2 minutes. They took me into a quiet room with my cat and asked a lot of questions, answered all of my questions, and then had the doctor see us. The doctor was equally patient and helpful, answering all of my questions. Despite having so many patients and being so booked, I never felt rushed, and they were courteous and kind the entire time. Can't speak to everyone there, but Dr. Loy Sun and the vet tech Melissa (I think?) were both really great.

It's expensive--but you get what you pay for. I would advise asking carefully about all of the charges/procedures they propose if money is tight, because in some cases I think they're recommending *everything* you might want to do to diagnose the issue, but some of it might be overkill, and very expensive overkill at that.

That said, I'm very pleased with the overall experience, and would highly recommend them to anyone who can afford them. My cat will likely be going in for surgery in the next few weeks; if my opinion about them changes after that I will update this review, but I imagine that won't be necessary.
Dr Hipp, Aiden and the front desk were all professional and caring. Thank you for seeing Bodhi.
The Doctors and staff were very attentive and knowledgeable. They helped our beloved dog get the medical attention he needed to get better. Nice, clean facilities and very communicative.
A+ team.   They were all fantastic.   Highly recommend Veterinary Speciality.   Thank you for the caring and support and taking great care of my fur baby.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
Competent team of people, efficient and happy to help, even through the night! Thank you again

We were checked in immediately and my dog was called for a thorough exam within 20 minutes. They triage based on the specific severity of the issue and other times I have been here the wait has been much longer. Overall, very happy with the facility and personnel is competent and caring.
We were very impressed with the Veterinary hospital, the staff and Dr Aiken.
They took their time, listened, tested and came up w/ a solid plan. Most importantly, they had great chemistry w/ the dog and knew how to handle unexpected challenges.

I had an excellent experience with Veterinary Specialty Hospital (VSH) in Sorrento Valley, from the initial phone call through my puppy’s discharge.

Around 6:00 AM, I called VSH because my 10-month-old puppy was unable to pass stool and could not keep down food or water. I had contacted another 24-hour emergency veterinary hospital closer to my home but was told I would need to wait until 8:00 AM to bring him in. Given his symptoms, I didn't want to wait, so I called VSH to see if they could evaluate him sooner.

The person who answered was empathetic, listened carefully to what was happening, and told me their lobby was currently clear and that if I could come in soon, they could get my puppy evaluated and seen by a veterinarian.

When I arrived, I was pleasantly surprised that the pre-check-in process had already been completed based on our phone conversation. I waited only about 15 minutes before a staff member came out and took my puppy back for his initial evaluation.

We then met with the veterinarian, who clearly explained the diagnostic process and what the next steps might be: X-rays, followed by an ultrasound if necessary, and potentially surgery depending on what they found.

Unfortunately, the imaging showed that my puppy had swallowed a large foreign object that had become lodged in his small intestine and needed to be surgically removed. He was in surgery by approximately 11:00 AM.

Throughout the day, the VSH team kept me informed. They called with updates and emailed me pictures so I could see how my puppy was doing. When I called with additional questions, I received prompt responses and never felt like I was bothering them or being left wondering what was happening.

The same level of care and communication continued through his recovery and discharge. The staff explained what I needed to do at home, his medications, feeding instructions, activity restrictions, and what to watch for during his recovery.

An emergency involving a puppy and unexpected surgery is obviously stressful, but the entire VSH team made the experience as stress-free as they possibly could. Everyone I dealt with was caring, professional, responsive, and compassionate.

I am extremely grateful to the doctors, technicians, and staff at VSH Sorrento Valley for taking such good care of my pup.

Ive been taking my dogs to VSH for a number of years now. We do have our regular vet, but VSH is the ONLY place that I am willing to bring my fur kids in case of an emergency or specialized care. Their team and facility are top notch. They will treat you and your babies with the upmost kindness and respect. Their bedside manner is also something notable as us parents can be a bit of a mess when our babies are sick. They will truly listen to your concerns and will always answer each and every question you may have. Do yourselves a favor and lock them on in speed dial, because this should the only place your babies should be treated in case of an emergency or specialized care. Forever grateful for them!
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
The ophthalmologist was very kind and professional while examining and explaining our dog’s eye condition. We were really impressed with how nice the staff was and the office.
The level of care here is second to none! I've brought my pup, who had a heat stroke (40% survival rate in San Diego area) and they literally nursed him back to life!
They are amazing !
I have been to Veterinary Specialty Hospital many times over the last 25 years. They are caring, kind, and do a wonderful job.
Excellent service.  I called ahead and they were prepared to check on Oscar.  We were quickly attended to.
We're delighted to hear about your positive experience at Veterinary Specialty Hospital of San Diego. Thank you for sharing!

My cat Pearl almost died from severe and sudden blood loss. She was hemorrhaging internally, resulting in shock and severe anemia.

Pearl found herself in desperate need of a transfusion. Unfortunately for Pearl, she has a rare blood type and there is no universal donor for cats. She needed B blood, and there were only 4 units total in the entire county of San Diego.

After she used all available blood products at her first hospital, she had to be transferred to VSH for additional transfusions. However, because of the rarity of her blood type, even VSH had a limited supply. During her stay, another B-type cat was admitted. VSH went above and beyond by calling over 30 hospitals from San Diego to Los Angeles to find more blood to make sure Pearl and the other patient could get the transfusions they needed. An employee from VSH went above and beyond by driving over 200 miles to secure more B blood.

The doctors and techs at VSH took excellent care of her. They remained in constant communication, tended to her every need, and even gave her some enrichment activities while in the hospital. She had a dream team of ER doctors and Criticalists.

Pearl thankfully survived her internal hemorrhage, but only because of the generosity of blood donors (and the Brilliant doctors and techs at VSH). Without the blood donor program, Pearl would have lost her life. Cats (and dogs) like Pearl depend on blood donors for life-saving care. Currently there is a severe shortage of feline donors. Please consider reaching out to the blood donor program at VSH to see if your cat is a candidate for donation - they could save a life like Pearl's!

I cannot express adequately how wonderful the entire staff at this animal hospital is! We had a very serious surgery for our pup, and Dr Fryer saved her life, and then she was cared for in the critical care area thereafter by amazing doctors and nurses. Everyone was so attentive, communicated constantly about her condition, and kept us updated on every single thing. She was so well cared for by these experts in their field, and the front desk staff and nurses showed such compassion and caring throughout. I HIGHLY recommend this hospital for anyone wanting the very best care for their pet. Thank you SO MUCH, Veterinary Specialty Hospital!
(Hazel is so grateful❤️)
Dr Henry and her tech Casey tool great care of our puppy Georgia. The Dr has followed up by phone for updates also. Ryley was great checking in and helping with the puppy.

Professional, smart and considerate Dr’s are all I’ve ever had at this facility.  There is no where better when you need the best.  Dr Foust (Dermatologist ) & Dr DeBerry (Internal Medicine) are the best of the best.
Thank you for always taking great care of my 4 legged kids!

Dr. Fryer literally saved my dog's life after another ver accidentally cut her spleen during a spay surgery. The hospital is clean, efficient and very friendly. I really appreciated all the updates from the doctors. They also spent time to explain all the after care instructions and medications. The best care ever!!

Vet was good, But they’ve gotta figure out how to solve their administrative and wait time six hours to go through the process. I would recommend going anywhere else if you can get in prior to using this option.
As always, the entire staff are kind and helpful!

The expertise here is extremely high.  That said, we waited 40 minutes to be put in a room, then met with the assistant and then Oncologist.  She was very knowledgeable.  The pricing was outrageously high. I understand that this is a specialty hospital, but our vet is 1/3 the price.  We asked if we could use both and were told no.  So we will be using our emergency/regular vet for treatment.
I can't say enough good things. I don't know where we would be without them. All the vets and techs are experts in their fields and the customer service is the best. I'm so grateful we found VSH.

ok , i know this is an emergency vet hospital and the doctors and staff are great. But the greedy gouging is not at all appropriate, especially when a pet owner is in a horrible state. in my case i took my 89 pound dog in after he got hit by a car. they charged 225 to examin him, and with  less than 5 days worth of pain pills and a shot and a blood test it was $560. they wanted $700 for a 2 view xray of his leg only. my regular vet just charged me $175 for the same x-rays.

Avoid if you can, because they will empty your wallet very quickly.

Staff is nice though, but the massive overcharging is truly greedy

First time appointment for internal medicine consultation with Dr Robb.  The staff were pleasant and professional.  Dr Robb spent a lot of time with us, actively listening and explaining in a way that was easy to follow.  The lab assessed the blood panel quickly and I was contacted the next day with results.  Very satisfied and will be recommending Dr Robb and VSH Sorrento Valley.
The best care. Magic healers. So grateful for the wonderful staff.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

I can only repeat my prior review.  The care of our  beloved dog is truly wonderful  by all the staff.  We are forever grateful   for the treatment of our pet and their concern for us.  I continue to  heartily and without question endorse VSH.  Thank you!

My cat had to be admitted and I could not have gone to a better place. We have taken pets here in the past for emergency visits but I have never had a pet hospitalized. He had multiple weird symptoms and labs and needed a little extra TLC. Every tech and doctor were great, thorough and patient. The inter al medicine team who saw him helped manage and facilitate follow ups and speciality attention. In particular Dr. Istvan was 10/10 she spent 30+ min with me on the phone updating and talking through his conditions and really put my mind at ease. Java thanks you all!
Dr Yeh and Savannah were fantastic! I have an 18-year old Chug recently diagnosed with melanoma and know he’s in good hands with VSH. Thank you for the fabulous care of Spike!

I took my senior diabetic pup in Friday night at 10pm. Staff were very kind and helpful.  Its our go-to place for emergencies. We didn't have to wait long to be seen and was home with medication by 11:30pm. Wonderful service!! Thank you!
Wonderful staff and doctor. My Frenchie went in for spine surgery and they took really good care of him. The cost was also reasonable

So many immediate red flags about this place.  They call themselves an ER business and the “ Vet” arrives an hour after my dog was brought in seeking help. He finally arrives and suggests several tests and quotes over  $700.00 to examine my dog. Not quite 5 minutes of his time and a 200.00 bill to get out of there. Don’t get me started about the person who “ took the vitals” .

Very friendly, but like many vets they really try to squeeze every penny out of visit. Added stuff to our bill beyond what we needed. What should have been a simple visit for antibiotics turned into almost 600 dollar charge, and that’s with us asking for items to be removed from invoice

Dr. Beevis and the staff were professional, courteous, and very attentive to Benji.  She took the time to explain Benji’s illness so that we understood how to care for him.  We are most grateful for your care of our puppy.

We had a wonderful experience at VSH with our young Scottish Fold, Sorcha, who has osteochondrodysplasia. We came looking for guidance on how to keep her comfortable and active with a lifelong condition.
I really appreciated that the focus was on Sorcha’s quality of life, not unnecessary treatments. We left with a practical plan focused on keeping her lean, active and strong, along with new options for pain management and future physical therapy.
Most importantly, we felt heard and much more confident about how to care for her going forward. Two days later, Sorcha is running around, playing and hunting us from behind the furniture. We know this is a lifelong journey, but we feel much better having VSH as part of her care team.

This is our go-to for specialty care because of the expertise available. We have also used them in emergencies. We recently saw Dr. Cheng, orthopedist and found the visit well worth it as it helped us better understand our dog's needs and care.
Great service as always, I feel comfortable trusting  my pets with Dr Arnell and all the techs here. Thank you.
Thanks for taking such good care of Peaches

DR Stevens and staff are phenomenal 🐶 Their radiation treatment for an inoperable nasal tumor has prolonged the life of my Wire Fox Terrier. She is happy and loving life . We are so grateful for the extra time we have with her 🐶❤️🙏 …
Our dog was bit by a rattlesnake.  They were very professional,  compassionate and clearly explained the options.  Will recommend them to everyone for 24hr emergency services.
Dr. Dereszynski is very caring and patient. She takes time answering all of our questions and concerns. So happy to have her as our trusted veterinarian!
We are very happy with Dr. Dereszynski’s care. She is so patient and she takes her time addressing all of our questions and concerns.
My almost 14 year old dog was in need of urgent surgery and we had an excellent experience from beginning to end. Thank you Dr. Chu and all the kind  techs and staff who clearly love animals.

Final update: she died.

on 6/5 she had to be euthanized. This hospital stay where I was pushed to pay 5k+ did not help her whatsoever and traumatized her right before her death. I was pushed to get a poo tube to keep her clean which sounded extremely uncomfortable but I guess the staff just didn’t clean her instead. I was gaslit. The staff said she was doing so much better than when she went in as she lay on the ground convulsing in front of me unable to stand.

They tried to charge me for meds I told them no to and only after I asked for management would they take them off.

I was given large pills that she couldn’t swallow when she wasn’t eating so there was no way for us to trick her into eating them.

We went to our trusted doctor the day after she got home and he gave her some water under the skin which seemed to help more than the entire hospital stay I paid 4k for.

She didn’t make it a week after this stay. Please know this place will see your dog dying, neglect them and try to take as much money from you as possible.

Update: overnight stay negligence. DO NOT leave your baby here.

5/31

Left my dog here overnight for diarrhea and was told she was being cleaned. Visited her to find her crusted in poo. Staff assured us they were cleaning her hut this looks worse than when I dropped her off.

I had to go back for an emergency visit (my vet requested I go back because they know her medical history). The experience was still horrible. We waited 2+ hours for our visit and by the time they got to her she had to be placed on a gurney.

My dog was hospitalized overnight where I received one update at 9 pm. Then nothing. I called in to find out they had been texting my husband who is not the primary and never visited. I was calling to ask them to make sure they keep me updated when I finally received a text….

Literally one minute after I get off the phone they call me again and ask if I’m Deidra. Anyway I urge you to avoid this place if you can. It feels very much like they are just too busy to actually care for pets.

10/6

They make you feel like your pet’s health is unimportant.

Waited 40 minutes past my scheduled appointment, which is fine, but when we finally got into see the specialist there was no explanation of why they wanted to do the testing described but it was also double the estimated cost. 10k for invasive diagnostics seems steep.

On top of that it was relayed more along the lines of “we want to do these tests. What do you want to do?” With no education on what was happening or the thought process behind these things. Once I had asked a million questions and decided to take the 10k plunge, they came back to tell me they can’t do the tests and I would have to come back either the next day at 7 am or in several weeks.

I needed time to decide. Then I went to the lobby to wait another 40 minutes for medication but was clearly forgotten about because I had to flag a nurse down for help.

I have been trying to get ahold of someone to help me with more questions about my dog’s medication and at this point it’s been a week to get a refill. That’s not what I called about. I have left several messages to get help but I’m just receiving refill texts back.

You are told to leave a message for a pharmacist to get a call back to answer your questions but I only receive texts that are 24+ hours apart and they answer one question at a time. I ended up having to spend hundreds of dollars to go to my usual vet to get help with this because their communication is so slow.

Because my dog has a special medication I’m not sure she will be able to get more by the time we resolve this issue and the worst part is my usual vet can’t fill it. So now I’m stuck in this cycle where no one will call me and I’m worried my dog won’t get the medication she needs. If all else fails I suppose I can come in for an emergency visit and they can actually help.

If you have a choice, I would choose a different specialty vet because they are too busy to give patients the actual care they need.

Dr. Loy Son, Austria, and the entire staff are highly professional, extremely kind, knowledgeable, and dedicated to their work. I am very pleased and happy that my fur baby’s GI problem has improved and resolved, thanks to their careful oversight of medications, lab work, and exams. I truly appreciate all their hard work and dedication!

Very Professional, Explained in easy to understand the diagnosis for our dog (Bo).
I would definitely recommend Dr. Moeller.

This might be the most important review you’ll read, as you decide where to your beloved family member.

This hospital may be able to stabilize your pet, but do they care? Absolutely not. Did they take oaths like every other vet? Yes. Do they uphold them? No. Why? Because they were called out for being full of ….lies, greed, laziness. Did they call, apologize, ask for another chance, and leave voicemails? Yes.

They don’t care about you, but their hands off “I have no idea who you are” manager is WERKIN for that corporate Ethos promotion—willing to go as far as preventing you from seeking care at any of their hospitals, including emergency care—for a service dog. That includes UC Davis, because of “tone”.

My tone was reflective of their “work”.

Funny, how pediatricians get yelled at all the time—they don’t want to take it out on the kids, but at Sorrento Valley, make sure you tip toe the staff’s fragile feelings after they’ve have to fabricated and faked their commitment to your pets care—hardly able to feign an interest.

If you think you’re getting personalized responses to your emails—I assure you, that’s you being hopeful, nothing is being added to a chart or communicated to two doctors that looks like they should have been on Scrubs.

What you’ll be getting is canned corporate scripts by the credit card clones at the front desk. This is a factory, not a hospital, but at least they have old, tiny rooms, blood on the floor, and bad coffee.

If you are looking for specialized care—you’ll have ten minutes with an internist who is perpetually on or just back from vacation—he won’t know a single thing about your pet, he will offer no ideas, no suggestion, and only when you formally complain—will he be reachable…will he call you—while he’s rushed and stressed because he has 72 patients he has to pretend to know that day.

HOW did this man negotiate the world best contract? To have had three vacations from Jan 2026 to April 2026?

Wait till you meet their neurologist, who appears to believe he walked out of greys anatomy— McSceevy. Nonchalant, relaxed, can’t be bothered to get up and do a real neuro exam, but do I look good in blue?

I can only imagine he wears his scrubs in public, through the weekend, and drives a mediocre Tesla—and treats it like a Ferrari.

This man watched a large dog get on a bench, then didn’t get up from his chair to even walk him down a hall—a standard neuro exam practice—proclaiming he had some pain, he was positive and “he knew” it was skin related, Then like a good corporate cog with a quota—offered me a $4500 MRI.

But get this, prior to bringing my WORKING LABRADOR in, for a month, I emailed staff, and was told I was assigned a team, assuring me, the most naive human on earth, were were putting my updates into their chart for my dedicated care team: no chart, no notes, no team.

Oh and it gets better—even after you read the one star reviews. My service Labrador, can’t go to their ER—or sister hospital…because of my tone.

One might say they care about their egos and profit over people and pets. But you be the judge. I was ALWAYS polite to their staff in person. There were no scenes. This isn’t days of our lives. Angry email? Yep. Warranted? Yep.

Should I also post the voicemail apologies? And the email apologies?

Don’t worry—no one was going to call you Cruella de Vil.
very good

The Vets, technicians, and front desk are amazing people. They have helped my dogs on numerous occasions and my dogs have received great care here. They are caring and straightforward. I appreciate their service and recommend this pet hospital.
Very kind and thorough staff!
Excellent surgical care for my dog. Thank you

Honestly, a mess. They took my dog to weigh him, and only returned him 1hr later after I complained. They ran tests without my permission or presence. We settled on getting subcutaneous fluids since they wouldn't do anything else. The vet promised it'd be done in 30mins. I was there for over 3hrs and got nothing I asked to be run on my sick dog. What's worse is this took a whole night away where I could have taken to any other emergency center to have him receive quality care.

We’ve have been going to VSH for a few years now and have spent probably between $10-20k between ER and specialist care for our pack. We have generally been happy with our experience, enough that I used to recommend them, but this week has forced me to make the hard call to change vets entirely.
After seeing the neurology department there, we decided to get a second opinion (no fault of their neurologist, I just wanted a second opinion) and ended up scheduling our dog for surgery same day at that other location due to his lack of mobility and risk of paralysis. Blood tests came back concerning and we had to pause surgery and she told me to reach out to our normal internalist (at VSH) to see if we should/could proceed as he has a complicated medical history which VSH has been treating. I called Tuesday evening to have him call us to talk about results. I was told I would get a call Wednesday or Thursday morning. Thursday morning nothing so I call again and am told he should call soon. Keep in mind, my dogs is losing the ability to walk more each day which I conveyed to them. Friday, I simply get an email saying I have to call to make a telemedicine apt, pay $130, and am given a single option for 3pm Saturday. I’m now backed into a corner hoping I can get my dog into surgery Monday.

Now, no one could call me for 3.5 days or more, but after that appointment I got a call, a voicemail, 2 texts, and 2 emails all in less than 24 hours to pay that $130 balance. Good to know their phone works when money is on the line, but not when my dog’s health is in question.
And to be clear, I’m not upset about having to pay or even schedule an appointment, I’m mad it took 3 days and me calling multiple times to get that information. All to say, I do not recommend this location and am disappointed in their lack of communication and caring.

I was very happy with all the staff. The Billing department kept me updated if any additional imaging, labs or procedures will be done. The doctors were amazing and kept me updated as well. Everyone was friendly and easy to get in contact with the office if I had any questions.
Always great , kind , and very accurate.

The team was amazing, compassionate, and very helpful both visits despite the diagnosis of my dog having ARVC and new medication. They monitored and took such great care of Pepper.

Dr. Parkins saw us both times, and was very helpful navigating us through both incidents. He patiently answered all of our questions and thankful to him for being invested in Pepper’s well being, very thoughtful and respectful.

I can’t recommend their team enough and trust them with my dog’s care.

Excellent staff (front desk, vet techs and Vets) and care for my dog in the ICU.  Communication for updates very good.  The veterinarians listened to my concerns and planning done together.  Very well run animal hospital.  Thank you all!
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

If you’re looking for a personal touch, doctors and staff who genuinely care about your pet and your concerns, VSH is the place for you.  Oncologist and staff very knowledgeable.  They listened to our concerns, answered our questions thoroughly and suggested a very thoughtful approach to a treatment plan. I highly recommend this veterinary hospital..

The entire staff is friendly, knowledgeable and professional. Unfortunately I have had to come here twice for emergency situations and each time we had a positive experience and went home with a healthier pup than we arrived with.

Gestational hospital ever!
They have always given us the best service!
Thank you!
Excellent care and communication. Thanks.

Update: Yes, it's true that there were conversations regarding the dangers of immunosuppressants and the anti-fungal treatment on the last TWO DAYS of my dogs life when she was switched to the correct medicine, MONTHS after my dog tested positive for valley fever, when she SHOULD have been placed on the anti-fungal.  A quick google search shows the dangers of my dogs treatment:

"Giving a dog with Valley Fever an immunosuppressant (such as prednisone or cyclosporine) without an antifungal puts them at severe risk of the fungal infection rapidly spreading, worsening, or becoming fatal"

We are still hoping for some accountability in the suffering and death of our beloved family member.

Brought our 3 year old maltipoo to see vet neurologist Dr. Schneider after she had two seizures and agreed to infectious disease testing. Somehow Dr. Schneider missed that one of the tests that he himself ordered was positive for Valley Fever and instead of putting her on an anti-fungal, he put her on an immunosuppressant which allowed the fungus to quickly spread throughout her body and lungs. Our dog's primary vet reached out to Dr. Schneider several times during the last few weeks of our dog's life via e-mail/phone but Dr. Schneider was too busy to discuss her care. It was horrifying seeing her struggle to breathe once she was admitted. They convinced me that it was in her best interest euthanize her.  (Though I do not blame the compassionate and competent vets who treated her on her last 2 days) I will never forget the way she sat up in terror as she was euthanized.  She wanted to live. When Dr. Schneider called a week later he was cavalier about the situation and it was obvious that he did not care. It's my belief that my dog would still be alive if I had never taken her to see Dr. Schneider. It's been almost a year and we still miss her everyday.
